🚀 soundwaves | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Simulating and visualizing sound wave propagation in 2D environments for acoustic analysis and design.
✨ Key Features: • 2D sound wave simulation • Browser-based interface • Scene drawing and material definition • Planar and axisymmetric modes • Finite element method (FEM) simulation
📖 Summary: SoundWaves is a 2D sound wave simulator that runs in the browser, allowing users to draw scenes, define materials, and simulate wave propagation. It supports both planar and axisymmetric modes, with waves solved using finite elements in Rust compiled to WebAssembly.
